- Model tends to overestimate prices, especially in early periods of the 30-day forecast horizon.
- Forecasts often overshoot after sharp price spikes in history, then fail to correct downward.
- Mean reversion is underappreciated — model fails to anticipate gradual pullback after peaks.
- Forecast bias is stronger in high volatility periods (e.g., 2024-05-20, 2024-08-16).
- Model underreacts to recent low prices — fails to adjust downward when history shows recent dips.
- Forecast horizon 30d shows persistent lag: model often predicts higher prices than true outcome, especially in the first 10 days.
- Model overweights recent history, leading to overfitting to recent spikes, ignoring longer-term trends.
- When true outcome shows a sharp drop after a spike, model fails to anticipate it — often continues upward or flat.
